input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v6 as V = Qe * tau, from a raise (reduced speed) then a decay (full speed) of the occupants' CO2, hatch closed throughout.

monitoring.reason: The three occupants of the lab breathe the raised CO2; they are also the CO2 source and must stay 3 and unchanged.

steps.why: Raise: reduced effective flow (about 0.4 m3/min) so the lab CO2 rises several hundred ppm above the 1800 ppm start; 40 percent is the datasheet's minimum speed when elevated.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min); about one time constant (first guess V 30 m3 gives tau 30 min, plus the 3.33 min lag). Whole test 55 min, under the 60 min ceiling.

abort.when: CO2 at or above limits.co2AbortPpm (3000 ppm)
the device refuses a step's speed command
a monitored person leaves 45 to 120 bpm, monitoring is lost, or one more person enters or a person leaves the lab

expected.rise: With 3 occupants (about 1.14 L/min CO2 at 0.38 L/min each) and Qe about 0.4 m3/min, the lab CO2 rises from 1800 ppm by roughly 20 to 25 ppm/min at first, to about 2200-2300 ppm at minute 20; it stays under co2MaxPpm 2800.
expected.decay: After the switch to 100 percent, the CO2 falls towards a lower equilibrium (C_eq about 1800 ppm or lower) as C_eq + (C0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau), lagged by about 3.3 min.
expected.volume: Fitted tau times Qe (1 m3/min) gives V_lab; the first guess is 30 m3 (tau about 30 min); accepted range 10 to 200 m3 (tau 10 to 200 min).
expected.disconfirm: A non-exponential decay, a tau far from the guess, an equilibrium that shifts with hab-b CO2, or hab-b CO2 following the lab's, shows exchange through the closed hatch or a non-mixed zone, so V_lab is not valid. A rise under about 200 ppm shows the source or flow differs from assumed.

hypotheses: Every hatch between lab and hab-b stays closed throughout; the exchange through a closed hatch (design 3 m3/min ventilation per station-topology) is not measured here and is not assumed to be zero. hab-b CO2 is recorded to reveal it.
The lab is one well-mixed zone; the six co2-1 sensors read the same air.
The three occupants keep their activity (awake, about 0.38 L/min each) and no one enters or leaves.
The scrubber's effective flow scales linearly with speed: Qe = 1 m3/min at 100 percent (datasheet); its lag of 3.33 min is absorbed by fitting only after the switch.
Records: lab CO2 every minute, hab-b CO2, scrubber speed commands and acceptance.

justifications.reason: Respects the signed floor and datasheet minimum.
Reduced speed for the raise, above the floor.
Full speed, known Qe, for the decay.
Below the signed ceiling and the 3500 elevated level.
Stays under abort; headroom above the 1800 start exceeds 200 ppm (test.startHeadroomPpm).
At the signed ceiling; steps total 55.

justifications.reference: rise about 23 ppm/min from G=3*0.38 L/min, V guess 30 m3, Qe 0.4 m3/min
justifications.reason: Gives about 400 ppm rise, above sensor noise, under limits.

justifications.reference: tau = V/Qe = 30 m3 / 1 m3/min = 30 min, plus lag 3.33 min
justifications.reason: About one tau or more; total 55 min under 60.
